name: Florian Kofler
headline: curious mind, researcher
summary:
I research how to integrate human expertise into AI models—and how to embed AI models into human-computer-interactive workflows. My work bridges the gap between algorithmic intelligence and human judgment, aiming to make AI systems more interpretable, collaborative, and effective.

My background combines expertise in AI model development, statistics, software engineering, sociology, and experimental Psychology, giving me a unique perspective on both the technical and human sides of intelligent systems.
